Univariate density plots of bootstrapping results

Source: R/univariate_density.R
univariate_density.Rd

Plots the univariate kernel density estimates of the VBGF parameters from bootstrapping results (ELEFAN_GA_boot, ELEFAN_SA_boot) and of the following assessment steps (see the argument `boot` of M_empirical, catchCurve, VPA and predict_mod) together with the confidence interval and the parameter value with maximum density (mode of the kernel density).

Usage

univariate_density(
  res,
  CI = 95,
  use_hist = FALSE,
  nbreaks = 10,
  truePar = NA,
  display_val = TRUE,
  display_median = FALSE,
  display_legend = FALSE,
  display_rugs = FALSE,
  mar = c(1.5, 2, 2, 0),
  oma = c(1.5, 0, 0, 0.5),
  mgp = c(2, 0.5, 0),
  tcl = -0.25,
  cex = 1,
  mfrow = NA,
  ylim = NA,
  pars = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

res

list of class `lfqBoot`

CI

numeric. Confidence interval level (Default: 95)

use_hist

logical. Plot histogram in addition to smoothed kernel density.

nbreaks

numeric. Number of breaks in the histogram.

truePar

if true parameters known lines can be added to graph

display_val

logical. Should the values of the CI limits and maximum density be displayed (Default: `TRUE`)?

display_median

logical. Should the median be displayed (Default: `FALSE`)?

display_legend

logical. Should a legend be displayed (Default: `FALSE`)?

display_rugs

logical. Should the individual estimates be displayed as rugs (Default: `FALSE`)?

mar

vector. Inner margins settings. See `?par`.

oma

vector. Outer margins settings.See `?par`.

mgp

vector. See `?par`.

tcl

vector. See `?par`.

cex

numeric. See `?par`.

mfrow

vector. See `?par` (default: NA).

ylim

optional list with y-axis limits, one vector per parameter (Default: NA).

pars

optional; names of the columns in `res$bootRaw` (parameters) to be plotted. Default (`NULL`): all columns.

...

Additional arguments passed to `par`.

Value

plot

Examples

data(alba_boot)
univariate_density(alba_boot)

univariate_density(alba_boot, pars = c("Linf", "K"))
